name: Kyouiku Jisshuu Mania
source:
Main character comes as an educational practitioner to a school where he wants to work as a teacher. He tries to seduce chief secretary, and it's taken on a digital camera. Now he is blackmailed into insulting a certain woman at school. After that case his wild senses go rampart.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到一所自己希望任教的学校进行教育实习。他试图引诱主任秘书，过程却被数码相机拍下。如今，有人以照片威胁他，逼他凌辱校内某名女性。那起事件后，他心底的野性开始彻底失控。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vndb-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
